items.title: Verizon Earnings Will Put Cost Cuts and SpaceX Fears Under the Microscope
items.summary: Verizon  is set to round out the Big Three telecommunications companies reporting earnings this week, and its cost-cutting push is likely to come into focus alongside potential competition risks from SpaceX.  Rivals AT&T and T-Mobile reported earlier this week, with both beating on earnings but missing on revenue.  As Verizon stock has outperformed both this year, the company likely faces a higher bar when it reports before the open Friday.

items.title: T-Mobile’s Churn Problem: Why Great Earnings Can’t Mask Saturated Mobile Markets
items.summary: T-Mobile US  stock was sliding on Thursday after the wireless carrier reported softer-than-expected second-quarter revenue, overshadowing an earnings beat.  T-Mobile reported adjusted earnings of $2.99, as revenue climbed 7.9% from a year ago to $22.8 billion.  Analysts were expecting earnings of $2.54 a share on revenue of $22.9 billion, per a FactSet poll.
